page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.36xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 144 dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 5.33 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached volumes. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance.

Given its high core count and dedicated CPU allocation, the instance offers high resource density for compute-intensive workloads. The qualitative cost profile reflects a high-tier hardware class designed for enterprise demands. It is suitable for large-scale web serving, high-performance computing, enterprise databases, and parallel processing workloads that require substantial CPU resources and high network throughput without local storage dependencies.
